summary: Follow-up verification of the 3 iteration_11 defects + full regression sweep. ALL 3 DEFECTS ARE FIXED AND VERIFIED LIVE. (1) GradeLevelSelect now derives group order from GRADE_LEVELS — [data-testid=dashboard-grade-select] renders 17 options (uk_reception + uk_y1..uk_y13 + uk_undergrad + uk_masters + uk_doctoral) for BOTH owner (Yusufm_1) and school_admin (Tester1), and select_option('uk_y7') succeeds and persists (dashboard subtitle updates to 'UK · Year 7 (KS3, age 11-12)'). NOTE: taxonomy has 17 entries, not 18 as the request stated — uk_reception..uk_doctoral is 17 values; all are present. (2) GlobalNav: nav-focus count = 0 on /contact, /pricing, /safety, /billing/success for owner, school_admin AND logged-out; no `Timer` token anywhere in GlobalNav.jsx; grep confirms zero '/focus' links across all of /app/frontend/src. (3) Landing hero eyebrow renders 'RECEPTION → UNIVERSITY' (CSS uppercase); no 'Preschool' anywhere. Google-session default: only 2 'high_school' strings remain in server.py (lines 512 + 587, both inside _grade_descriptor/paper_level_map legacy alias maps as designed); both /api/auth/session code paths (~395, ~1118) now use uk_y10. Regression: re-ran the full iteration_11 suite — 32/32 PASS (was 31/32); previously failing TestFocusRemoval::test_no_focus_links_anywhere_in_nav now passes. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_fix_verification.py (15 tests, 13 pass). Frontend re-verified: 3 logins 200 + /auth/me consistent, DPA gate accept, sn-dreams visible for owner AND school_admin with sn-focus=0, /dreams renders with 0 error elements, /contact shows schoollearnsupport@pm.me. ONE NEW (pre-existing, not a regression) backend defect found: grade_level is not validated server-side.

minor.issue: No UK-only grade_level validation. PATCH {"grade_level":"high_school"} returns 200 and persists the legacy non-UK value on the user document (reproduced on tester@tester.org; value restored to uk_y10 by the test teardown). update_profile (server.py:477-483) blindly $sets any value in the {name, grade_level} allow-list. Iteration_11 only ever tested VALID UK values, so this gap was missed. A user stuck with a non-UK grade silently falls back to the uk_y10 descriptor in AI prompts and shows a raw slug in the UI (gradeLevelLabel returns the raw value when unknown), and GradeLevelSelect renders with no matching option (blank/first-option selection).

Same gap: register with grade_level='middle_school' returns 200 and stores it (server.py:325 `req.grade_level or "uk_y10"` — no membership check). RegisterRequest.grade_level is a plain Optional[str]. Recommend a Pydantic Literal/validator or a shared UK_GRADE_LEVELS set validated in both register and update_profile.
STILL PRESENT from iteration_11 — dead focus-session endpoints and collection with no frontend consumer. Not fixed this round; cosmetic/dead-code cleanup only.

issues: STILL OPEN from iteration_11 (not in this round's scope): the 30-day retention window is never stated and /api/progress/export + /api/progress/reset are not reachable from the UI, so the DPA S11 'save a file before the monthly reset' right has no entry point.

critical_code_review_comments: The grade-taxonomy contract is enforced only in the frontend dropdown; the API accepts anything. Define one authoritative UK_GRADE_LEVELS set in server.py and use a Pydantic Literal/field_validator so register, PATCH profile and any future importer share it — this is the same class of drift bug as the iteration_11 GradeLevelSelect regression, just on the backend side.

GradeLevelSelect's new derived-order loop is correct and drift-proof; consider applying the same 'derive, never hardcode' rule to paper_level_map/_grade_descriptor which still enumerate grades by hand.
server.py is still 2909 lines — split DPA, retention, auth, promo and AI-prompt logic into routers.
SideNav and GlobalNav still duplicate role->menu logic (the /focus leak lived only in GlobalNav). Consolidate into one role-nav source of truth to prevent a repeat.

rca_of_the_issue: All 3 iteration_11 defects are genuinely fixed. Verification evidence: (a) GradeLevelSelect.jsx now builds `order` by iterating GRADE_LEVELS and pushing unique g.group, so group renames can no longer drop options — live DOM shows 17 <option> values and select_option('uk_y7') resolves and persists via PATCH /api/auth/profile. (b) GlobalNav.jsx navForUser() no longer contains any /focus entry for owner/school_admin/teacher/student/individual, and `Timer` is absent from the import list; nav-focus and nav-focus-m counts are 0 on all 4 GlobalNav-rendering pages for every role tested. (c) Landing.jsx line 22 reads 'Reception → University'. NEW finding root cause: update_profile (server.py:477) and register (server.py:325) treat grade_level as a free-form string — the allow-list filters WHICH keys may be written but never WHAT values, so the retired 'high_school'/'middle_school' slugs are still writable through the public API even though the UI can no longer produce them.
